hook_text: Three descriptions of a phone plan. One is lying. Can you catch it?
clip_script: Is the flow diagram plus fifty, then times two equivalent? Test m equals ten: ten plus fifty is sixty, times two is 120. The formula gives seventy. Not equivalent — the order of operations has changed the relationship.
visual_style: Three cards — a table, a machine, a formula — each fed the number 10; two light up R70 green, one flashes R120 red.
pacing: Line-up of suspects, one test, reveal the imposter.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to translate any rule between words, tables, machines and formulae.
